system.notes: Second test cut for the A/B path, built for both Pi 4 and Pi 5. Carries app 2026.08.0-beta.9.

notes: An appliance can update its own proxy boards. The native tarball now carries the ESP32 binaries and ota.json the container image always had, so a hub installed from the SD image can push firmware over the air and install a board over USB from its own console — both of which silently did nothing before. Nothing changed for a hub running in Docker.
